sources.prompt: Create one exquisite FULL COLOR narrative illustration for a Chinese Dream of the Red Chamber motion comic. Landscape 1536x1024. Rich Qing-dynasty gongbi heavy mineral colors with refined modern Chinese manhua facial drawing, azurite blue, malachite green, cinnabar, antique gold, silk textiles, nuanced natural light. Full-bleed painting, no text, no captions, no border, no logos or watermark. Strong cinematic composition with foreground/midground/background. Expressive believable hands and faces, fully clothed and nonsexual. Delicate ink contours, painterly foliage, polished illustrated-book quality. Scene: the gates of Daguanyuan under a gathering storm, an interpretive scene of household crisis suited to chapter 74 and the Guiyou continuation chapter 91. Wang Xifeng, regal young Chinese woman in dark crimson embroidered robe, elaborate gold hairpins, stands center under the eaves clutching folded accounts, composed but anxious face, at 52% x 45% y. A servant carries a warm amber lantern behind her. Monumental CLOSED cinnabar double doors, blue-green painted beams, wet gray paving reflecting the lantern, foreground rain and bamboo leaves, brooding indigo clouds. Deep saturated teal and crimson punctuated by lantern gold. Tense, majestic, beautiful; no military combat, no violence, no corpses.
